description: Spell out numbers in words — cardinal, ordinal, currency amounts, cheque wording, years and Roman numerals — in English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese (PT) and Brazilian Portuguese, with each language's real grammar (French "quatre-vingts" / "et un", Spanish "veintiún mil" / "un millón", German compounds, Italian elision, long and short scales). Integers up to 36 digits, decimals ("twelve point five"), negatives. Also converts Roman numerals back to numbers. For invoices, cheques, contracts, accessibility and voice output. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/number-to-words

currency.description: ISO code: USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, INR, JPY, CNY, CHF, MXN, BRL

number.description: Number (digits, optional sign / decimals; "1,234.50" ok), or a Roman numeral

style.description: English: uk = "one hundred and five" with commas; us = "one hundred five"
